description: The Berlin Centre of Competence for Water deposits flow-cytometry observations from a managed aquifer recharge transect near Berlin, Germany. The README dates sampling to August through December 2023 and names a recharge basin, observation well and abstraction well. Zenodo lists three public FCS archives totalling about 257 MB and a README under CC BY 4.0. The README describes automated BactoSense measurements of total, intact and damaged cells and high and low nucleic-acid fractions, expressed as cells per millilitre. It says the interval varied but could be as short as six hours. These measurements could calibrate or test simulated microbial transport and drinking-water quality changes between recharge and abstraction. They are field observations, not a groundwater-flow model or a continuous sensor service. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Berlin transect release. The README labels the dataset CC0 while Zenodo metadata states CC BY 4.0; the README also cites the earlier version DOI. Reuse rights need confirmation. The FCS archives were not downloaded, so individual event counts, timestamps and processing with flowCore were not checked.
